## About
We are a family owned and operated collision and automotive repair shop on Callaghan Rd in San Antonio. We fix collision and body damage, take care of dings and hail dents with paintless dent repair, and keep a mechanic on duty for general repairs.
Customers often get to know Amos and the Alcala family. One reviewer who was paying out of pocket said Amos understood they were strapped for cash and was the most reasonable and empathetic shop they found. Another said Amos spent a lot of his own time working things out with their insurance company.
Our body shop is fully equipped, and we use computer diagnostic systems on the mechanical side so we can find the problem and get you on your way.

## Services
- Collision and body repairs: Our fully equipped body shop handles collision and body repairs to insurance company mandated standards.
- Paintless dent repair: From minor dings to hail damage, we work dents out without repainting.
- General mechanical work and repairs: A mechanic on duty for general mechanical work and repairs on your vehicle.

## FAQ
Q: Are you open on Saturday?
A: Yes. Saturday hours are 10:00 AM to 3:00 PM. We are closed on Sunday.

Q: Can you fix hail damage?
A: Yes. Our paintless dent repair covers everything from minor dings to hail damage.

Q: Do you do mechanical work too, or just body work?
A: Both. We have a mechanic on duty for general mechanical work and repairs.
